d_evidence: internal/distributed/proxy/httpserver/utils.go:639-645 (v3.0.0) Int64 分支以 json.Number(dataString).Int64() 接受字符串形态主键,无 JSON 类型校验

d_evidence: internal/distributed/proxy/httpserver/utils.go:639-645 (v3.0.0) 同一转换路径:字符串主键被 json.Number 接受,无 JSON 类型校验

d_evidence: internal/distributed/proxy/httpserver/utils.go:615-635,770 (v3.0.0) cast.ToBoolE/ToInt16E/ToFloat64E 接受字符串形态标量,无类型匹配校验
